items.source: overrideAnnotation - the composed annotation that declares the @BeanOverride annotation which registers this processor
items.translation: overrideAnnotation - 声明了注册此处理器的 @BeanOverride 注解的组合注解。

items.source: At least one composed annotation that is meta-annotated with @BeanOverride must be a companion of this processor and may optionally provide annotation attributes that can be used to configure the BeanOverrideHandler.
items.translation: 至少有一个由带有 `@BeanOverride` 元注解的复合注解，必须是此处理器的伴生注解，并且可选地提供可用于配置 `BeanOverrideHandler` 的注解属性。

items.source: This method will only be invoked when a @BeanOverride annotation is declared on a field — for example, if the supplied field is annotated with @MockitoBean.
items.translation: 此方法仅在字段上声明了 `@BeanOverride` 注解时才会被调用——例如，如果提供的字段已使用 `@MockitoBean` 注解。

items.source: This method will only be invoked when a @BeanOverride annotation is declared at the type level — for example, if the supplied test class is annotated with @MockitoBean.
items.translation: 此方法仅在类型级别声明了 `@BeanOverride` 注解时才会被调用——例如，如果提供的测试类使用了 `@MockitoBean` 注解。

items.source: The default implementation returns an empty list, signaling that this BeanOverrideProcessor does not support type-level @BeanOverride declarations. Can be overridden by concrete implementations to support type-level use cases.
items.translation: 默认实现返回一个空列表，表示此`BeanOverrideProcessor`不支持类型级别的`@BeanOverride`声明。具体实现可以重写它以支持类型级别的使用场景。

items.source:
Implementations are required to have a no-argument constructor and be
stateless.
items.translation: 实现必须具有无参数构造函数且为无状态。

items.source:
Note that the test class may not be directly annotated with the override
annotation. For example, the override annotation may have been declared
on an interface, superclass, or enclosing class within the test class
hierarchy.
items.translation: 请注意，测试类可能未直接添加 `override` 注解。例如，该注解可能已声明在测试类层次结构中的接口、父类或外部类上。

items.source: Create a BeanOverrideHandler for the given annotated field.
items.translation: 为给定的注解字段创建一个 `BeanOverrideHandler`。

items.source: Create a list of BeanOverrideHandler instances for the given override annotation and test class.
items.translation: 为给定的覆盖注解和测试类创建BeanOverrideHandler实例的列表。

items.source: the BeanOverrideHandler that should handle the given field
the list of BeanOverrideHandlers for the annotated class
